snippet.title: His NASCAR Dream Cost a Billion Dollars
snippet.description:
Episode 4 of Fireball, the DC Solar documentary series.

In 2018, Jeff Carpoff announced DC Solar was moving to NASCAR Sundays. Bigger drivers. Bigger money. Bigger stage. But nobody was asking where the money was coming from.

This is the story of the machine that made it all look legitimate. The press conferences, the executives, the raceway presidents, and the man at the center of it all: Alex McGhee, DC Solar's VP of Marketing, who believed he was building something real.

Featuring Daniel Baldwin (@DannyBTalks), NASCAR content creator, providing an outsider's perspective on the sponsorship that changed everything.

I was DC Solar's filmmaker. I filmed everything. This is what I saw.

🔥 FIREBALL: I Filmed the $1B Ponzi Scheme from the Inside

snippet.title: Fireball: Official Trailer | I Filmed the $1B Solar Ponzi
snippet.description:
For years I filmed inside DC Solar, the billion-dollar Ponzi scheme that was later raided by the FBI. I thought I was documenting a clean-energy success story.

Instead, I was filming one of the largest frauds in U.S. history from the inside.

I shot over 22TB of footage - none of which has ever been seen publicly until now.

FIREBALL is my independent doc-series telling the story as it actually happened.

Episode 1 premieres December 18 on YouTube.

snippet.title: The CEO Who Built a Fake NASCAR Empire
snippet.description:
I was DC Solar's in-house filmmaker for five years. This is the NASCAR chapter.
How a billion-dollar Ponzi scheme bought its way into Chip Ganassi Racing, sponsored Kyle Larson and Ross Chastain, and used America's most popular motorsport to build legitimacy for the largest criminal fraud in the Eastern District of California.

FIREBALL is an independent documentary series built from 25 terabytes of footage only the FBI has seen — until now.
